1.0.label: Per-asset future value and yearly market-value breakdown
1.0.notes: Baseline before effective return percentages were added to yearly projections. Use this commit as the rollback reference for Version 1.0.

1.1.label: Monthly-contribution effective return percentages
1.1.notes: Adds effective cumulative return percentages against contributed capital for total portfolio and each asset, while retaining monthly contribution compounding. Adds visible ENGINE v1.1 badge.

1.2.label: Equity Sleeve stock-style allocation
1.2.notes: Adds stock-style selection inside the system-defined equity allocation: Stabil, Balanced, Growth, Agresif, and Custom. Splits the equity sleeve into Core/Blue Chip, Dividend/Income, Growth/Second Liner, and Tactical/Trading while keeping total portfolio equity exposure unchanged. Custom allocation must total 100%.

1.3.label: Three starting-capital planning modes
1.3.notes: Adds three connected starting modes: Goal / monthly accumulation, Lump Sum for clients who already have investable cash, and Investor-Trader Cash Buffer where a chosen percentage remains liquid and only the remainder is allocated to investment assets. Also clarifies goal-mode result labels as target, projected value, target gap, and required monthly contribution.

1.4.label: Separate mode-specific Wealth questionnaires
1.4.notes: Each planning mode now has its own KAPAN, MAMPU, and NYAMAN questions instead of reusing one generic questionnaire. Goal mode focuses on deadline flexibility and contribution capacity; Lump Sum focuses on liquidity need, capital dependency, concentration, and lump-sum drawdown; Investor-Trader Buffer focuses on core horizon, buffer usage, separation of emergency funds, dependence on trading profits, capital concentration, maximum drawdown, and active-market experience. Answers must be selected explicitly and still map into the same suitability guardrails so outputs remain connected to the allocation and projection engine.
